description: J2 (NIP) case with synthetic identifiers, classified ASSISTENCIAL_OUTRO -> nip_routing ELABORAR_RESPOSTA (regulatorio-ans authors the response; still always human, never auto). Asserts the emitted dossier never carries the synthetic CPF canary '123.456.789-09'. The ABS check is scoped to the emitted `dossier` object (the corpus carried into the engine as `dossie_gustavo`), not the raw graph state -- see test_dossier_admin_evals.py module docstring for why a whole-state scan would be the wrong scope. The canary is absent from this golden's own input/narrative; the mutation check (mutate_plant_canary) proves detection by injecting it into the LLM's own narrative output.
recorded_llm: NIP assistencial de outro tema, com documentacao suficiente; instrucao de resposta encaminhada ao grupo regulatorio-ans, decisao final permanece com o humano responsavel.
